card.statement:
Let $Z$ be a closed subset of $\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}$, union of finitely many ${G_{\mathcal{O}}}$ -orbits.

The object $P_{Z}(\mathbf{k})$ admits a filtration in the abelian category $\mathrm{P}_{{G_{\mathcal{O}}}}(Z,\mathbf{k})$ parametrized by $\{\lambda\in X_{*}(T)^{+}\mid\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}^{\lambda}\subset Z\}$ (endowed with any total order refining $\leq$ ) and with subquotients isomorphic to

$\mathsf{F}(\mathcal{J}_{*}(\lambda,\mathbf{k}))\otimes_{\mathbf{k}}\mathcal{J}_{!}(\lambda,\mathbf{k}).$

There exists a canonical isomorphism $P_{Z}(\mathbf{k})\cong\mathbf{k}\mathchoice{\mathbin{\mathop{\otimes}^{L}}_{\mathbf{Z}}}{\otimes^{L}_{\mathbf{Z}}}{\otimes^{L}_{\mathbf{Z}}}{\otimes^{L}_{\mathbf{Z}}}P_{Z}(\mathbf{Z})$.

$\mathsf{F}(P_{Z}(\mathbf{Z}))$ is a finitely generated free $\mathbf{Z}$ -module and we have $\mathsf{F}(P_{Z}(\mathbf{k}))=\mathbf{k}\otimes_{\mathbf{Z}}\mathsf{F}(P_{Z}(\mathbf{Z}))$.
card.label: Proposition 12.3

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
